description: This file defines the interface for a PUCCH detector class, including configuration structures for Formats 0 and 1, detection result structures, and virtual detection methods. It is part of a 5G NR physical layer implementation, specifically for PUCCH signal detection.

classes.name: pucch_detector
classes.description: Interface class for detecting PUCCH transmissions for Formats 0 and 1, with configuration and result structures.

methods.name: detect
methods.description: Detects a PUCCH Format 0 transmission, returning the PUCCH message and channel state information.

methods.name: detect
methods.description: Detects multiplexed PUCCH Format 1 transmissions, returning a map of detection results for each scheduled transmission.
